notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/89b04af58c5b84dd651c83496f019cc2b16619e5.png[/img]

[b]Psychoscopy 1.0 Released![/b]

After a long and dedicated development journey, we are happy to finally release Psychoscopy in its full version.

Since day one, we have worked to bring all of our ideas to life and enrich the world of the game as much as possible. Along the way, we have carefully listened to your feedback to improve the experience, making the gameplay smoother and incorporating many of the features you asked for.

With Psychoscopy, we set out to go beyond traditional horror games, aiming to deliver a different and unforgettable experience. This journey into the depths of the mind wasn’t just about fear; we wanted to provoke thought, evoke discomfort, and spark curiosity. We envisioned a world where players could track ghosts and capture their presence on camera, discover hidden items and companions, communicate with spirits through equipments, and even perform rituals to banish them, a fully interactive experience where every moment invites exploration.

We want to thank everyone who stood by us and supported us throughout this process.

[*] Fixed:
Resolved an issue where the Complete All Quests objective sometimes appeared incomplete at the end of the game.

notes.title: Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
[list]

[*] Optimized:

*We have been working on renewing and improving some of our systems for a long time to address certain issues we were aware of but couldn't fully understand the cause of. With this patch, we have largely resolved the problem of clients occasionally experiencing lag while running. Since we had to rewrite some core systems in a more optimized manner, we would appreciate any feedback if you come across an overlooked issue.

[*] Fixed:

* Fixed an issue where the Engineer Meter did not update the point when turned off.
* Fixed an error in calculating the total playtime on maps.
* Prevented the "Press E to open" prompt from appearing on entity-bound doors in the Story map when they were locked.
*Fixed an issue where certain dialogues generated empty subtitles.
*Fixed a bug in the Story map that allowed progression without speaking to Renata on the bridge.
*Fixed an issue where an empty quest could be created in the Story map.
*Prevented the "Find the key" quest from appearing in the Story map.
*Fixed a visual issue with the player's character at the end of the Story map.


[*] Changed:
*In lobbies, if a player has a previously saved item list, it will now be automatically selected when choosing a character.
*The game's Summary UI has been completely revamped and updated. At the end of a game, you will now have access to more detailed information, including entities defeated on the map, the player who killed or revived you, and a summary of your map-specific statistics.

[*] Added:

*A toggle option has been added under Display Settings for lobby camera movements, allowing players who find the camera motion uncomfortable to enable or disable it.
*A Credits screen has been added to the game's main menu.

[/list]

[list]


[*]  Event:
- Join the newly added time-limited event map, Frostbitten Hollows, to participate in the event. On this map, you will encounter 4 cursed snowmen. Banishing each creature on the map will lift one of the curses from the snowmen. Once all 4 curses have been lifted, you will have completed the event and will be rewarded with 5 Christmas Pouches. You also will be rewarded with a lobby trophy on your first completion.

In addition, Christmas Pouches have been added to the maps, allowing you to earn extra event currency. If you manage to open the fuse-locked door in the hidden room, you will find 5 Christmas Pouches and a unique vehicle artifact that will be permanently added to the account of the player who claims it.


[*]  New Game Mechanics
- Hidden Rooms
This game mechanic allows you to discover hidden rooms on maps, containing various items. The primary purpose of this mechanic is to be base for other systems to be added in the future.

With this update, we’re introducing this mechanic and have added one easy hidden room to the new event map, Frostbitten Hollows, for you to explore. Inside this hidden room, you’ll find a fuse-locked door.


- Pet Capture
This game mechanic enables you to capture certain wild animals roaming freely on the map. There’s nothing extra you need to do. Simply approach the pet on the map and claim it to permanently add it to your account.

During the event, this system is active exclusively on the Frostbitten Hollows map, where you can capture the special Grey Stag.

notes.title: Big Christmas Update 0.4.5
notes.content:
[h1] Big Christmas Update [/h1]


Today we are happy to announce our one of the biggest update of this game. As we fixed many of the bugs from the beginning of our journey, we were able to focus on implement many new mechanics to the game. We have changed couple of base systems to improve your gameplay and give us more freedom to implement another feature. Although this is one of the biggest update we have ever done, we wanted to launch christmas event on time so we decided to update game part by part, that means this is the first part of the update.

We wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year.


[h1] Christmas Event [/h1]

[*] You can now find a pine tree on the maps that has a Present next to it.
[*] When any player click this Present box, every player can earn random reward from it.
[*] It has 5 minutes cooldown time
[*] Rewards can be; Money, Experience, Christmas Cat or Santa Sledge.

[h1]Reworked[/h1]

[*] Main menu changed and recoded.
- We have changed Main Menu design, and fixed couple of errors that causes by menu itself.
- Now it's more user friendly, and give you much more information.
- Resetting to Default and Detecting the System features added to Settings menu.
- Seperate shop system is removed and now you can easily switch between shops from the top slider.
- Redeem system added to the game, we will share Redeem Codes with you time by time.

[*] NPC events reworked
- Some evidence events like "Writing a Book" now have higher priority than other events.
- If NPC cannot complete the randomly selected event, it will select another event instead of delaying.

[*] Video camera recording system fully reworked.
- We have changed the video camera system to make your recordings more accurate.
- This is still experimental to see how it affects to the game and network.

[h1]Added[/h1]

[*] 3 new Maps; Algus Town, Twilight House and Hangar added to the game.

[*] 6 new Characters added to the game.
- This is the first update that we have announced 6 characters in once from the beginning.
- These 6 characters implement couple of new mechanics to the game.
- Aaliyah (Adventurer)
-- Aaliyah can equip her own special item Torch, which slows down Mystics and scare any creature that hate from fire.
- Hera (Healer)
-- Hera can equip a small Resurrection Stone which we have removed from the game in previous updates.
-- Hera can place that Resurrection Stone to the ground to resurrect someone.
-- Once someone use the Resurrection Stone, it will be destroyed.
- Lilly (Cursed Child)
-- Lilly has no special item to equip but she can use Cursed items without affected by their curse.
-- Also she change the behaviour of the cursed items.
-- Arbatel: Doesn't lower her sanity while tracking the ghost.
-- Bear: Can banish Tiyanak or Moroi when it placed to their area.
-- Goat Head: Can banish any type of Creature except Stalkers instead of just Spirituals and Ghosts.
-- Mirror: Creatures never try to attack.
-- Verum: She can use verum directly without a lighter and heart bottle.
- Elena (Alchemist)
-- She has a special salt item which lower the requirement time for banishing Spirituals from 2 minutes to 1 minute.
- Taeyang (Electirician)
-- He can equip a Generator with him which is working like a power station when it connected to house lights.
-- You just need to place it to the ground and run it.
-- It will affect all switch in specific range.
- Vincent (Cameraman)
-- He has own special hand camera which has nightvision mode in it, and let you to earn more money from recording.

[*] 16 Character Skins added to the game.
- Character skin system is newly implemented feature to our game. 
- They are mostly added for level system but you could buy couple of skins from the Skin Shop in the Shop section of Main Menu.

[*] 8 new Vehicles added to the game.
- We have added Historical Ambulance, Rider, Blaze, Army Jeep, Old Man, Helicopter and Plane for Level system.
- We have added Santa Sledge for Christmas event.

[*] 13 Pets added to the game.
- 5 color of cat added to the game. 3 of them can be buyable, and 1 coming from level system while last one is coming from christmas event.
- Beagle
- 2 color of Cane Corso added to the game. 1 of them can be buyable and another one can only obtained from level pass.
- Celtic Wolfhound
- 2 color of Hellenic Hound
- 2 color of Pug added. 1 of them can be buyable while another one only obtained from level pass.

[*] 3 new Item Skins added to the game.
- A strong flashlight skin added.
- Spotlight and Double Spotlight skins added.

[*] 2 new Items added to the game.
- Glowstick (Has a very low amount of light, can be equipped 6 at once)
- Strong Pills (Can replenish huge amount of sanity)

[*] Level pass system implemented to the game.
- You can now collect rewards at specific levels from the Level Pass section on Main Menu.
- We haven't fully implemented all the rewards to our game yet, you will able to collect them once we implemented.

[*] Pet selection section temporarily added to lobby screen.
[*] Car selection section temporarily added to lobby settings menu.
[*] Added a temporary text that shows game time in end game screen.
[*] New quests added to the game.
[*] A graveyard added to Train Yard.

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[*] Arbatel detection system changed and improved to make it more accurate.
[*] An issue that forces Mystics to attack players again and again fixed.
[*] An issue that causes Mystics and Stalkers consume your Protection Talisman and Crucifix fixed.
[*] Now quest requirements change depends on maps.
[*] White lady continue to spawn gravestone as she cannot banish with it anymore.
[*] Couple of issues that causes drawn symbols not working.
[*] An issue that causes items drop down of the map.
[*] Wrong owning amount of items that bought before the updates.
[*] Changed keys keep resetting to default when game closed.
[*] An issue when the player disconnected from the session, still seems connected.
[*] Couple of map bugs that causes player stuck.
[*] Fog strength balanced for maps.

[h1]Changed[/h1]

[h1] Added [/h1]

[list]
Personal item system added to game.

[*]There are 4 different items (bone, skull, picture and daily) that belongs the someone and they spawn on maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/73f3a8565ff2551569a9eebc55ed119882f91300.jpg[/img]

[*]You can earn Special Item point by taking picture of them.

[*]Taking them from ground also give money.

Cursed items added to game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/b52df51c75fb62ffe56dac8dec9de4af4e4d4796.jpg[/img]

[*]There are 5 cursed items currently which are Verum, Teddy Bear, Arbatel, Goat Head and Mirror.You can find these items on the specific locations of maps.

[*]Verum is a one-use item that shows the Creature type when it activated in the ghost room or remnant room.
If Verum used in Empty ghost area, it randomly spawn a creature and it's candles changes the color depends on the creature type. (Blue : Ghost, Spiritual : Green, Demon : Red and Mystic : Purple)
To use Verum you need a light source like lighter, fired candle, etc. Then after fire it's candles, you need to pour blood in it by using Heart Bottle.

[*]Teddy bear is like a Voodoo Doll
If there is Moroi or Tiyanak on the map it directly connect with their souls.
If you drop the Teddy Bear on the ground it will directly burn and Moroi or Tiyanak will get angry directly so they can be more aggressive.
If you place it in one of their area by using Middle Mouse Button (Default place key not dropping ground) directly calm it down and it doesn't get angry.

[*]Arbatel is a book which guide you towards random ghost area.
You only need to place book the ground and wait a couple of seconds then a small light will guide you through the area.
You can lose sanity too quickly while it's active so you should be careful to use it.

[*]Goat Head is a equippable item which is using for exorcism.
When you use it inside the Spiritual or Ghost room it will directly banish the creature in the room and you earn a exorcism money, then it spawns a Demon in the room.
You can earn more money by banishing the demon from the room.

[*]Mirror has different actions for different types.
If you use it in a Ghost room, Ghost can show itself, or hands can attack you from the mirror.
Spirituals only attack you from the mirror by hands.
Demons can show itself, attack from the mirror by hands or it can attack player directly.

[*]Resurrection stone added to game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/df0d63662c962c9b864b7be64067ab693972d2f8.jpg[/img]

You can find Resurrection Statue in specific locations of the maps.

You can resurrect by interacting it while he has a light ball in his hands.

When you interact the ball start flying to the sky and after a couple of seconds you will be resurrected.

Everytime someone use the Statue to resurrect, the time to reneval is increases 1 minutes until reach 5.

That means, if someone resurrect at the 1st minute, second player can resurrect 2nd minute, 3rd at 4th minute, 4th at 7th minute, 5th at 12th minute, 6th at 17th and so on.

You will be 50% of sanity when you resurrected.

[*]2 new characters Nierva and Alice added to game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/fc05949caf1063c617b2683e0e42696e2b7a816f.jpg[/img]

[*]Nierva has a special item named Talisman and her occupation is Exorcist.
She has an item Talisman which works totally same with Totem, but she can take 2 with her at the beginning of the game, and it directly banish the ghost without any ritual.

[*]Alice is an Engineer and has her own device Engineer Meter
Engineer meter has 4 different modes in it which are EMF, Thermo, Carbon and Infrasound.
It lets the player detect any of them without needing any other equipment.

[*]Ghost Light item added to game | Remnant system added to game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42540833/982cb4e155710afd9e2c6add06acafe68eda74e2.jpg[/img]

Now there are remnants that spawns the map at the beginning of the game.

Once player use Ghost Light in the area, players can take the picture to earn money

Also using Grimore on remnant gives a exorcism money
